pipeline.title: Spruce’s successful FDA talks plant seeds for Q4 filing of ultra-rare disease drug
pipeline.summary: Spruce Biosciences has taken another step toward filing for FDA approval of its ultra-rare disease drug candidate, ticking off some of the manufacturing tasks needed to submit the long-awaited application.

pipeline.title: [Podcast] (Season 2) The Progress Profile: Alzheimer’s Research in Focus
pipeline.summary: This podcast explores how leading Alzheimer’s experts are working to bridge the gap between clinical trial design and frontline care.

pipeline.title: Roche, Eli Lilly net FDA approval for first-of-its-kind Alzheimer’s biomarker blood test
pipeline.summary: Roche and Eli Lilly have won FDA clearance for their latest Alzheimer’s disease diagnostic.

pipeline.title: Werewolf transforms into Ambros via reverse merger to support phase 3 push for rare disease drug
pipeline.summary: Werewolf Therapeutics’ hunt for strategic alternatives has ended. Ambros Therapeutics has agreed to merge with Werewolf in an all-stock deal and has raised $150 million, positioning the biotech to take its lead rare disease drug candidate through to a filing for approval.

pipeline.title: Boehringer places phase 1 study of investigational drug on hold to examine ‘safety event’
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has suspended a phase 1 trial of an investigational small molecule drug while it seeks to understand a “safety event,” although the German pharma isn't shedding light on the nature of the incident for now.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—China's IIT scrutiny; Daiichi Sankyo, AZ ph. 3 win; Leo, Tanabe's dermatology deal
pipeline.summary: China's investigator-initiated trials, once praised for their speediness, have been drawn into scrutiny for a lack of transparency. AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo's Enhertu earned a win in a phase 3 non-small cell lung cancer trial. Tanabe Pharma secured a $435 million payout for

pipeline.title: Merck-Moderna cancer vaccine win spurs stock jump, speculation of Keytruda-like impact
pipeline.summary: As the dust settles on phase 3 data that added $45 billion to Moderna’s market cap, analysts have begun to ask a question that could define cancer care in the coming years: Can use of the vaccine be as broad as Keytruda?

pipeline.title: Pursuing patient options, Novo kicks off trial testing smaller doses of Wegovy pill
pipeline.summary: Just eight months after it introduced its Wegovy pill, Novo Nordisk is testing the GLP-1 in smaller doses in the phase 3 OASIS 5 study.

pipeline.title: Developing a Global Clinical Trial Strategy for Emerging Biotechs
pipeline.summary: Discussing how small biotechs can accelerate clinical development with fit-for-purpose global clinical trial strategies.

pipeline.title: Tolerance Bio jumps into phase 2 with $260M deal for thymus-targeting fusion protein
pipeline.summary: Tolerance Bio has vaulted into the clinic by agreeing to pay NeoImmuneTech up to $260 million for rights to a fusion protein in certain thymus-related indications in the Americas and Europe.

pipeline.title: Merck, Moderna’s personalized cancer vaccine slows recurrence in phase 3, setting up approval push
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co. and Moderna's personalized mRNA cancer vaccine has successfully lengthened recurrence-free survival when paired with Keytruda for patients with high-risk skin cancer. The phase 3 win sets the partners up to potentially seek accelerated approval.

pipeline.title: Kolon TissueGene shrinks workforce after pivotal osteoarthritis trial miss
pipeline.summary: Following a phase 3 knee osteoarthritis failure that its CEO acknowledged caused “great disappointment and concern,” Kolon TissueGene is laying off 37 employees at its Maryland headquarters.

pipeline.title: Regeneron's Pasatru scores FDA approval in ultra-rare bone lesions disorder
pipeline.summary: Regeneron's Pasatru has crossed the finish line with FDA approval after more than ten years of development. The drug is only the second approved treatment for FOP, an ultra-rare genetic condition that causes patients' soft tissues to turn to bone.

pipeline.title: Young startups miss out on biotech venture funding rebound, MassBio says
pipeline.summary: A new report found that the sizes of seed rounds and Series A financings for Massachusetts biotech startups are going in opposite directions, as funding slows for young companies with the “riskiest science.”

pipeline.title: Lilly covers lifelong obesity journey in new GLP-1 Medicaid access campaign
pipeline.summary: The campaign adds older adults to the obesity conversation and is anchored by Lilly's "A Life Covered" short film, which highlights a woman's decades-long weight loss journey.

pipeline.title: Merck, AZ lawsuits against Medicare price negotiations swatted down
pipeline.summary: Courts in Maryland and Washington, D.C., have rejected separate lawsuits by Merck and AstraZeneca against the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services' drug price negotiation program.

pipeline.title: Hansa lays groundwork for Nasdaq debut ahead of US kidney transplant drug verdict
pipeline.summary: With the FDA expected to weigh in on its kidney transplant drug, imlifidase, shortly before year-end, Hansa Biopharma is mulling over its stock listing options in the U.S.

pipeline.title: Safety concerns spur FDA to again halt testing of Regenxbio gene therapy
pipeline.summary: Investigators detected masses on the spines of five patients who received its Hunter syndrome treatment, leading to the program’s second clinical hold this year.

pipeline.title: FDA extends review of Capricor cell therapy; Pain drug startup to go public
pipeline.summary: The agency is now reviewing an updated application for deramiocel with a “refined” indication. Elsewhere, a startup co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy is taking a speedy path to the public markets.

pipeline.title: Cellares, a cell therapy manufacturing specialist, to lay off 100 employees
pipeline.summary: The restructuring comes after an unnamed "large pharmaceutical customer" terminated a contract with the company, Cellares CEO Fabian Gerlinghaus posted on LinkedIn.

pipeline.title: After Trump order, RFK Jr. seeks input on US pediatric vaccine recommendations
pipeline.summary: HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has joined President Donald Trump in a renewed effort to challenge how the United States formulates its childhood vaccine recommendations. In a Request for Information, Kennedy has asked for public comment over the next 30 days on whether vacci

pipeline.title: Qiagen appoints new chief executive after 9-month search
pipeline.summary: Molecular diagnostics specialist Qiagen has a new CEO as Jonathan M. Pratt takes the reins.

pipeline.title: TME holds onto $1B dream for brain cancer drug as search for partners nears conclusion
pipeline.summary: TME Pharma’s hunt for a partner for its brain cancer drug is closer to bearing fruit as the German biotech clings to its hope of generating $1 billion in peak sales from the asset.

pipeline.title: Cellares CEO seeks to 'resize' company after loss of 'large' cell therapy manufacturing customer
pipeline.summary: With its ascent seemingly unstoppable in the last few years, automated cell therapy manufacturer Cellares is facing some tough new realities.

pipeline.title: Roche commits to lean-mass preservation with Hanmi obesity deal
pipeline.summary: For $190 million up front and as much as $2.3 billion overall, the Swiss drugmaker is building its portfolio with a shot that aims to spur weight loss but spare muscle tissue.

pipeline.title: Regenxbio gene therapy refiling plan derailed by FDA hold over spine MRI findings
pipeline.summary: The FDA has put a clinical hold on Regenxbio’s RGX-121 over asymptomatic spine MRI findings, derailing the biotech’s plans to refile for approval of the once-rejected gene therapy candidate.
